Claude API Pricing Reference

This page summarizes pricing and usage details for Anthropic's Claude models, including claude-sonnet-4-6, as of the current release.

Pricing

Prices are per million tokens (MTok) and vary by model tier:

  • Input: $3 / MTok
  • Output: $15 / MTok
  • Prompt-cache write: $3.75 / MTok
  • Prompt-cache read: $0.30 / MTok

Quick-Start Example

Send a simple message using the Python SDK:

import anthropic

client = anthropic.Anthropic()
message = client.messages.create(
    model="claude-sonnet-4-6",
    max_tokens=1024,
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello, Claude"}],
)
print(message.content[0].text)
